title: Chinese Face Solo #17 (중국 · 20대 · 당황한 · 메이크업 홍콩풍(강화) · 피어싱 P50+쥬얼리 · 스티커 야광 초승달(관자놀이))
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Chinese woman — Chinese fresh natural beauty luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, mid 20s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, glossy dark-brown loose waves past the shoulders. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a small glow-in-the-dark crescent moon sticker at each temple, softly glowing neon blue-green against the dark, all stickers flat on the skin, clear of the eyes and lids and clear of the piercings, eyes wide and startled, unsure where to look, a deep blush spreading across the cheeks and nose, the lower lip lightly bitten, a flustered, embarrassed expression — a photograph of a real Chinese woman's face (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick bronze septum ring with a smaller bronze ring above it and two bronze rings through each nostril; a straight bronze bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three thick bronze bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; a bronze Medusa stud above the lips; a big bronze hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a bronze labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small bronze studs along each jaw; a curved row of small bronze studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized bronze hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine bronze chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings. Each piece carries small opals set into the metal. All jewelry is real bronze, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Jewelry: besides the piercings she wears four to six pieces, layered of mixed-metal necklaces and chains resting on her neck and collarbones, and four to six pieces, layered of mixed-metal hair ornaments set in her hair, all of it real, without covering her eyes, her face or her piercings.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
